svg.title: Short Rations: Stencilled ration-issue cards
svg.desc: Short Rations (1D): a trick-taking card game for bread, on the card table seen from above, drawn as stencilled ration-issue cards. Fisk's hand of eight is fanned at the bottom; three cards of the current trick lie in the centre beside the bread basket, which holds one loaf fewer than there are seats. The deck shrinks as chairs empty: the suit of a departed player is stamped withdrawn and taken out, and two chairs at the table stand pushed in.
